jyutping: jat1 hai6 A jat1 hai6 B

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial construction for presenting two alternative actions or possibilities.

examples.english: Either we go out tomorrow, or we stay home.
examples.traditional: 一係聽日去街，一係留喺屋企。
